categories.name: Sample Information
categories.description: What you're adding: raw samples or existing AnnData / SpatialData tables.

categories.name: Run params
categories.description: CellTypist labels for raw samples. Ignored for existing tables.

parameters.name: Input type
parameters.description: Raw samples get QC metrics, CellTypist labels and Scrublet scores. Existing tables are added as they are, with nothing recomputed.
parameters.help_text: Both kinds can go in the same store. Samples are identified by their sample_id column, or by file name if there isn't one. Set SAMPLE_COLUMN to use a different column.
extra_data: Existing AnnData or SpatialData table (as is)

parameters.name: List of paths to samples
parameters.description: Files, folders or globs, separated by commas. Accepts .h5, .h5ad, AnnData .zarr and SpatialData .zarr. EX: /data/samples, /data/atlas.h5ad
parameters.help_text: Paths must be inside attached data assets. Folders aren't searched recursively. Samples already in the store are skipped. MuData isn't supported.

parameters.name: Storage Location
parameters.description: Icechunk repo or .zarr folder to add samples to. Accepts a data asset, local path or s3://bucket/prefix. Created if it doesn't exist.
parameters.help_text: Use S3 for a store you'll keep adding to. /data is read-only, a store in /results becomes read-only once saved as a data asset, and /scratch is cleared when the run ends.

parameters.name: Origin of s3 (optional)
parameters.description: S3 location to write to when the storage is a read-only data asset linked to a bucket. EX: s3://bucket/prefix
parameters.help_text: Only needed for an external data asset with a linked S3 bucket.

parameters.name: New store format
parameters.description: Format of the store when it doesn't exist yet. Ignored for an existing store, which keeps its format.
parameters.help_text: Auto makes a .zarr path a plain AnnData zarr and anything else an icechunk repo. Icechunk keeps a history of every run; a plain zarr must be a local path, not S3.
parameters.default_value: Auto (.zarr path is zarr, else icechunk)
extra_data: Auto (.zarr path is zarr, else icechunk)

parameters.name: Celltypist Model
parameters.description: CellTypist models used to label the cells. A store only accepts the option it was created with.
extra_data: CellTypist Immune_All High and Low labels

parameters.name: Custom Celltypist model (.pkl, optional)
parameters.description: Your own CellTypist model instead of the dropdown, e.g. for a spatial gene panel. Separate several with commas. EX: /data/models/my_model.pkl
parameters.help_text: Leave empty to use the dropdown. The file name sets the label column names, so keep using the same file for a store.
